user.title: Set up Conversational Assistant
user.description: Mobile App notification devices and speakers are discovered only when a destination list is needed, not during Home Assistant startup. After setup, open Configure to add one or more named Zalo destinations.

data.dismiss_on_clear: Treat swiping away as dismiss (Android only)
data.confirm_targets: Ask which destinations and speakers to use before saving each reminder
data.speaker_enabled: Offer discovered speakers as reminder destinations
data.zalo_webhook_enabled: Process commands from an existing Zalo webhook
data.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Allow Zalo to query and control Home Assistant

data_description.confirm_targets: Voice Assist and Zalo commands discover phones and speakers on demand, list them with Zalo destinations, then wait for a reply such as: choose 1 and 3.
data_description.speaker_enabled: Compatible media_player entities are scanned only when a destination list is needed, and the result is cached briefly.
data_description.tts_entity_id: Optional. If left unset, Conversational Assistant automatically uses the first available TTS entity.
data_description.zalo_webhook_enabled: Does not create a new endpoint. Your existing webhook or automation calls conversational_assistant.process_zalo_webhook and passes its JSON body in the payload field.
data_description.zalo_webhook_bot_account_id: Required when Zalo webhook processing is enabled. Enter the bot account ID from your own Zalo webhook payload; it is used with isSelf and uidFrom to ignore messages sent by the bot itself.
data_description.zalo_webhook_account_selection: The account selector expected by zalo_bot.send_message, usually the bot phone number. If empty, the first configured Zalo destination account is used.
data_description.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Routes device control, state, room, area, floor, weather, and calendar requests from Zalo into Home Assistant. Only entities exposed to Assist can be used.
data_description.zalo_conversation_agent_id: Choose the Home Assistant or custom Conversation agent that should interpret Zalo commands. Home Assistant Assist exposure settings are still enforced for calendars and built-in controls.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Conversational Assistant instance is supported.

init.title: Conversational Assistant options
init.description: Manage on-demand phone/speaker discovery and Zalo destinations. Currently configured Zalo destinations: {zalo_count}.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Mobile App notification devices and compatible speakers are discovered on demand, cached briefly, and shown in the same destination list as Zalo.

data_description.confirm_targets: When enabled, both Voice Assist and Zalo reminders are saved only after you reply with destination numbers or names.
data_description.speaker_enabled: When a destination list is needed, Conversational Assistant scans media players that support play_media, excludes unavailable TVs and projectors, and caches the result briefly.
data_description.tts_entity_id: If no engine is selected, the first available TTS entity is used automatically.
data_description.zalo_webhook_enabled: Does not create a new endpoint. Your existing webhook or automation calls conversational_assistant.process_zalo_webhook and passes its JSON body in the payload field.
data_description.zalo_webhook_bot_account_id: Required when Zalo webhook processing is enabled. Enter the bot account ID from your own Zalo webhook payload; it is used with isSelf and uidFrom to ignore messages sent by the bot itself.
data_description.zalo_webhook_account_selection: The account selector expected by zalo_bot.send_message, usually the bot phone number. If empty, the first configured Zalo destination account is used.
data_description.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Routes device control, state, room, area, floor, weather, and calendar requests from Zalo into Home Assistant. Only entities exposed to Assist can be used.
data_description.zalo_conversation_agent_id: Choose the Home Assistant or custom Conversation agent that should interpret Zalo commands. Home Assistant Assist exposure settings are still enforced for calendars and built-in controls.
